statement: Using the substitution $u=\ln x$, evaluate $\displaystyle\int_{1}^{e}\dfrac{\ln x}{x}\,dx$.
solution: Let $u=\ln x$, so $du=\frac1x\,dx$. When $x=1$, $u=0$; when $x=e$, $u=1$. Hence $\int_{1}^{e}\frac{\ln x}{x}\,dx=\int_{0}^{1}u\,du=\bigl[\tfrac12u^{2}\bigr]_{0}^{1}=\tfrac12$.
hints: Change the limits to u=0 and u=1.
